types.name: FLevelGeneration
types.doc:
One LevelGenerationComponent's play-time generation, as the scene system
runs it: the grammar, the seed by role (the host decides and sends it, a
client waits for it, offline uses its own), the layout, the nine passes,
then prefabs and level-module Level Instances into the scene.

members.signature: static bool Run(Scene& scene, EntityID entity)
members.doc:
False while a client still waits for the host's seed; true once the
component generated (or refused an invalid layout).

The grammar a component names, the built-in facility when it names none
or the file does not load.

members.name: HashGrammar
members.doc: FNV-1a over the grammar's text: equal grammars, equal hashes.

members.name: GeneratorKey

The replication key of a generator: its entity id, which the level file
gives every machine alike.

types.name: LevelGenerationComponent
types.doc:
Drop one in a scene to generate the level at play: the grammar (the
built-in AJAX facility when empty), the seed, and where the grid starts
(the entity's position). The runtime half reports what came out.

members.name: randomSeed
members.doc: A new seed each play (logged, so a run can be reproduced).

members.name: requireValid
members.doc: Refuse to spawn a layout that fails any of the nine validation passes.

members.name: replicateSeed
members.doc:
In a session the host decides the seed (its own, or a random one) and
sends it; clients build nothing until it arrives, then build the same
level. Off, every machine uses its own Seed / Random Seed.

types.name: FLevelRandom
types.doc:
A deterministic 32-bit PCG stream. Its own, not FRandomStream: the level a
seed produces is pinned by golden hashes across builds, so the generator's
randomness must never change when something else's does.

members.name: Below
members.doc: Uniform in [0, bound); bound 0 returns 0.

types.name: FLevelGraph
types.doc:
The room graph (audit G2: graph first). Always a tree: Insert and Attach
keep it one, Replace only retypes.

types.name: FLevelPlacement
types.doc:
Where one room's module landed: grid origin (the cell its rotated
footprint's minimum corner sits on) and quarter turns clockwise.

members.name: SocketLinks
members.doc:
Per module socket (same order as the definition): the node it connects
to, or -1 when it is open (and gets a cap).

types.name: FLevelWorldSocket
types.doc: A socket after its module was rotated and placed: world cell and side.

types.name: ELevelSide
types.doc:
Grid sides. +Y is north on the grid and -Z in the world (the engine's
forward), +X is east in both.

types.name: FLevelSocket
types.doc:
An opening on a module's edge: the cell it is on (module-local, before
rotation), which side of that cell, and how wide the doorway is.

types.name: FLevelModuleDef
types.doc:
A chunk on the 4 m grid (audit G1): a footprint of whole cells, its
sockets, the prefab that builds it, and the numbers the validator reads.

members.name: Level
members.doc:
A module authored as a level of its own (`.mmap`, edited like any
level) and placed as a Level Instance. Wins over Prefab when both are set.

members.name: ScanCost
members.doc: Estimated scan cost (rays' worth of surface) the validator budgets.

members.name: NoCarry
members.doc: A room two people cannot carry a Heavy object through.

members.name: Replace
members.doc: Match -> Produce[0]: retype one room.

members.name: Attach
members.doc: Match gets new neighbours, one per Produce entry.

members.name: Insert
members.doc: Edge Match-MatchOther becomes Match-Produce...-MatchOther.

types.name: FLevelRule
types.doc:
One rewrite rule of the grammar (audit G3). Rules are picked by weight
among those that apply; MaxApplications < 0 is unlimited.

types.name: FLevelGrammar
types.doc:
The whole generator configuration, one `.levelgrammar` MDF asset: the
starting chain, the rules, the module catalogue and the validation budget.

members.name: CapPrefab
members.doc:
Placed on every socket nothing connected to, and on every edge where
two modules touch without a doorway (so the level never shows two
coplanar walls back to back).

members.name: CreateDefault
members.doc:
AJAX's facility: fifteen rules over entrance, corridors, hubs, labs,
storage, offices, maintenance, stairs, dead ends and the objective.

types.name: ELevelSeedRole
types.doc: Who decides the seed of a generated level.

members.name: Offline
members.doc: No session: generate from the component's own seed.

members.name: Host
members.doc: Hosting: decide the seed, generate, and send it to every client.

members.name: Client
members.doc: A client: generate nothing until the host's seed arrives.

types.name: FLevelSeedRecord
types.doc:
What one generated level needs to be the same level on every machine: the
seed — everything else is the grammar, which ships with the game. The
grammar's hash rides along so a client running different content says so
instead of quietly building another level.

types.name: FLevelSeedReplication
types.doc:
FLevelSeedReplication — the host's seeds, sent once per level instead of
the level. A module level becomes Level Instances whose actor ids derive
from the seed and the room, so the clients that build from the same seed
hold the same actors under the same ids, which is all replication needs to
address them. A client that joins late asks, and the host answers with every
seed it has handed out this session.

members.name: SetRoleOverride
members.doc:
A dedicated driver that runs the session itself can say which side it is;
Offline clears the override and the session decides again.

members.name: Publish
members.doc: Host: remember the seed and send it to every client.

members.name: RequestFromHost

members.name: EnsureHandlers

Re-installs the session handlers after a session started (the session
drops game handlers on leave). Cheap when they are in place.

types.name: FLevelSpawnItem
types.doc:
One prefab the spawner would place: a room module, a cap on an open
doorway, or a shared wall between two rooms that touch without one.

members.name: Level
members.doc: A room module authored as a level: placed as a Level Instance.

types.name: FLevelSpawner
types.doc:
Turns a layout into prefab placements and instantiates them. Grid +X is
world +X, grid +Y is world -Z (the engine's forward); a module prefab is
authored with its origin at the centre of its unrotated footprint and its
doorways on the edges the grammar lists.

Instantiates every planned prefab and places every level module;
returns how many landed.

members.doc:
Takes the level modules of a layout back out (a regenerate, or a new
seed from the host). Returns how many actors left.

The Level Instance a module room becomes. Named from the seed and the
room index only, so its actors get the same ids on every machine that
generates the same seed — what lets the network address them.

members.name: SharedWallEdges
members.doc:
Grid edges where two rooms touch without a doorway: each gets one
shared wall, never the two modules' own walls back to back.

types.name: FLevelValidator
types.doc:
The nine validation passes of audit G4, run over a generated layout:
1 Embedded        every room of the graph has a module on the grid
2 NoOverlap       no grid cell holds two modules
3 SocketsMeet     every linked doorway meets its partner face to face
4 SharedWalls     touching rooms without a doorway get a shared wall
5 CapsPlaced      every open doorway is capped (never a hole into void)
6 Reachable       every room is reachable from the start through doorways
7 CarryClearance  the critical path is wide enough for a two-person carry
8 ScanBudget      total and per-room scan cost within budget
9 PathAndAcoustic critical path length in range, every room within the
portal depth of the path (so it is heard from it)
